A rate is the slope of the used space over the runs (for a volume: the runs after its last change). It needs 3 runs.
A change is a size that changed by more than 1%, or used space that fell by 5% of the size or more, between two runs.
For a volume that is back again, the change is its drop below 85% (ontap_volume_warn_pct).
